category: probability and stochastic processes / foundations of probability
canonical_claim: For a probability measure P and a sequence of measurable events A_n, probabilities converge to the probability of the set limit: for increasing A_n, P(A_n) tends to P(union_n A_n); for decreasing A_n, P(A_n) tends to P(intersection_n A_n). Probability normalization supplies the finite-measure condition for continuity from above.
